title: Fleet Comeback Credit Basis Where the Two Repairs Were Done — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the credit basis of a comeback follows where the two repairs were done.

| Where the repairs were written | Credit basis |
|---|---|
| The original repair at a different store of the group from the repeat | the original repair's labor charge, because the repair warranty refunds the labor of the job it covers |
| Both at the same store, and the repeat labor charge is larger than the original labor charge | the original labor charge plus half of the amount by which the repeat labor charge exceeds it, the store and the customer sharing the extra time the repeat took |
| Otherwise (same store, repeat labor charge not larger) | the repeat labor charge |

**Terms.** The repeat labor charge is the latest customer-pay labor charge of the paid repair order (the repair order of the latest payment received on the account), and the repeat was written at the store on that charge. The original labor charge is the total of the customer-pay labor charges on the original repair's repair order and concern line, and the original was written at the store on those charges.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
| Original labor | Repeat labor | Stores | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 310.00 | 455.00 | different | 310.00 |
| 310.00 | 455.00 | same | 382.50 |
| 310.00 | 240.00 | same | 240.00 |
